summary: #smallpoems Some times we need not seek deep meaning into typos words flows letters lost order for naught no rhyme, reason no time. just squeeze in one tweet not neat yet power in names flower of fame petals shrivel souls unsettle with misspelled drivel
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
Some times we need not seek
deep meaning into typos
words flows
letters lost
order for naught
no rhyme, reason
no time. just
squeeze in
one tweet
not neat
yet power in names
flower of fame
petals shrivel
souls unsettle
with misspelled
drivel
